# Class: OrdersClient

A client for the Orders API.

## Methods

### create()

> **create**(`order`): `Promise<Order>`

Sends `POST http://localhost:8093/api/v1/orders` and returns the stored order.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `order` | `OrderInput` | The `sku` and `quantity` to order. |

### list()

> **list**(`page`): `Promise<Order[]>`

Sends `GET http://localhost:8093/api/v1/orders?page=<page>`.
